detail.longDescription:
Monitor and manage your Linux, Windows, macOS, Unraid, TrueNAS and cloud servers from your Android device.

Monitee is a self-hosted server monitoring app that lets you monitor CPU usage, memory, disks, network activity and running processes in real time. Receive alerts when your servers need attention, manage Docker containers, control services and troubleshoot issues from anywhere.

Whether you run a homelab, a home server, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS or dedicated servers, Monitee helps you stay informed and take action without needing to open a terminal.

Monitor your servers

• CPU usage
• Memory usage
• Disk space
• Network traffic
• Running processes
• File systems
• System uptime

Get notified before problems become outages

Create custom monitoring rules and receive notifications when:

• CPU usage is too high
• Memory usage exceeds your limits
• Disk space is running low
• Network traffic reaches your thresholds
• And much more

Manage Docker containers

• Start, stop and restart containers
• View container status
• Read container logs

Manage Linux systemd services

• Start, stop and restart services
• Check service status
• Read journalctl logs

Manage Windows

• Start, stop and restart Windows Services
• Browse Windows Event Logs

Supported platforms

• Linux
• Windows
• macOS
• Unraid
• TrueNAS
• Raspberry Pi
• Cloud VPS providers
• Any system capable of running monitee-agent

Monitee connects to your servers through monitee-agent, an open source, self-hosted monitoring agent that runs on your own infrastructure, so your data stays under your control.

monitee-agent is available on GitHub and can also be installed directly from the Community Apps catalogs in Unraid and TrueNAS.

Getting started:
https://monitee.app/get-started/

Source code:
https://github.com/Krillsson/monitee-agent
